The export is not encrypted: anyone who gets the file can read it. Your SMS messages are not included; to save them, use Backup, data and privacy → Export.
The export failed. Nothing was saved.
Erase everything Dak stores on this phone

Dak\'s index (categories, labels, OTPs, accounts and ledger), rules and their run history, the activity log, scheduled messages, the recycle bin, settings, app lock, backup passphrase and schedule, consent records and Dak\'s encryption keys. Dak then closes and starts fresh next time.

Your SMS and MMS messages stay in the phone\'s message store, which other apps share. To remove them, delete the conversations in Dak first, or use your phone\'s settings. Backups and exports you saved to a folder or cloud storage stay there until you delete them. Dak stays your default SMS app until you choose another.
Tip: export your data or make a backup first if you might want it back.
